items.question: What is the UCP Playground?
items.answer: A sandbox where an AI shopping agent runs live Universal Commerce Protocol operations against a storefront you choose. It resolves the store's /.well-known/ucp profile, picks its MCP or REST shopping endpoint, and shows every tool call and response.

items.question: Which stores can I test?
items.answer: Any storefront that publishes a valid Universal Commerce Profile at /.well-known/ucp with a dev.ucp.shopping service. The playground prefers the MCP transport and falls back to REST.

items.question: Do I need an account?
items.answer: No. Anyone can send up to {limit} messages for free. Create an account to run unlimited sessions against your own connected store.
